subject: Ink file rev 2 is on disk in both homes (sides written both ways, no-mirror paragraph, gun and holster left to Ziggy): dispatch from 8cf54aef…, not d14d9b43…
body:
NQ Claude revised the ink file on both flags within minutes. Dispatch, when Ziggy gives the word, from rev 2: references/From NotebookLM/NQ-NAGUAL-R3-20261013/INK_JAMES_GROK_PROMPT_20261014.md, sha256 8cf54aef96c212ad72655a6311414ff54502b8383a1754f271ab8825cb1795b5, 10,463 bytes, identical in New_11/_ROUND_3/; package MANIFEST.csv now 59977dc43eafe91ad2cc3f1f574da7d626d5e64441f8e075ec8586a358091cb3; all verified by me at 05:30 UTC. The version attached to be857cb0 (d14d9b43…) is superseded.

What changed: every side in the map table and the prompt is now the character's with the viewer's in brackets; the inked bare arm is his LEFT (viewer-right, outside the sleeve; the right arm sleeved and uninked); intent at his right temple (viewer-left); see under his left eye and the five dots on his left cheek (viewer-right, where Grok's existing marks sit); the death column on his left flank (viewer-right); a SIDES paragraph at the top of the prompt tells Grok not to mirror. The prompt no longer says "no gun, no holster"; it keeps the reference as supplied and adds or removes neither, that question being Ziggy's. The sides flag is closed. Still Ziggy's before the look locks: the holster (kept empty or gone), the outer ring's seven-word quote in English, Spanish or in-world script, the candidate lock itself, and the story option for how James came by the words (DECISIONS open item 23). My delta CHARACTER_JAMES_INK_DELTA_20261014.md is updated for rev 2; DECISIONS item 58 likewise. No run requested by me.

attachments.description: The ink map and corrective Grok prompt, rev 2 (sides both ways; holster left to Ziggy). Candidate lock.
